summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K announcing the Scrip Reference Price for its 2026 first interim dividend scrip alternative. The interim dividend is 8.88 US cents per ordinary share; the Scrip Reference Price is US$13.193810 per new ordinary share, based on the five-day average middle-market LSE price from the 10 September 2026 ex-dividend date, converted at 16 September 2026 Bloomberg WMR spot rates. Record date was 11 September 2026, with a 149-share minimum holding. This is a routine dividend mechanics notice, not a special situation; watch participation rates and resulting share issuance dilution.
